installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# steamcmd Base Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Image to install with is 'ghcr.io/parkervcp/installers:debian'

## just in case someone removed the defaults.
if [[ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]] || [[ "${STEAM_PASS}" == "" ]]; then
    echo -e "steam user is not set.\n"
    echo -e "Using anonymous user.\n"
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## SteamCMD exits 0 even when it downloaded nothing, so the binary is what decides.
for attempt in 1 2 3; do
    ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) ${INSTALL_FLAGS} validate +quit
    [[ -f "/mnt/server/Holdfast NaW" ]] && break
    echo "attempt ${attempt} left no server binary, retrying"
done

if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/Holdfast NaW" ]]; then
    echo "-----------------------------------------"
    echo "Holdfast NaW is missing after three tries."
    echo "Check the disk limit; the install needs 11 GiB."
    echo "-----------------------------------------"
    exit 1
fi

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## The Steam API loads this one by absolute path; without it the server never lists.
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

cd /mnt/server
mkdir -p configs workshop logs_output logs_archive logs_adminactions logs_chat logs_playerlogin logs_score logs_vac

## Configs live here rather than the root, where a game update would overwrite them.
for file in serverconfig_default.txt serverconfig_frontlines_default.txt serverconfig_aly.txt serverconfig_empire.txt serverconfig_odlaw.txt serverconfig_zombies.txt StarWarsEvent.txt; do
    [[ -f configs/${file} ]] && continue
    curl -sSLf -o configs/${file} "${CONFIG_REPO_URL}/${file}" || rm -f configs/${file}
done

## A server with no config cannot boot, so fall back to what the game ships.
if [[ -z "$(ls -A configs)" ]]; then
    echo "no configs fetched from ${CONFIG_REPO_URL}, seeding the stock pair"
    cp serverconfig_default.txt serverconfig_frontlines_default.txt configs/
fi

[[ -f bannedplayers.txt ]] || curl -sSLf -o bannedplayers.txt "${CONFIG_REPO_URL}/bannedplayers.txt"

## The server sets a file monitor on each of these at boot.
for file in bannedplayers.txt bannedmachines.txt bannednames.txt muteplayerschat.txt muteplayersvoip.txt micspammers.txt serverAdmins.txt serverVIPs.txt; do
    [[ -f ${file} ]] || touch ${file}
done

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Config File
variables.description: Which file in configs/ the server loads. The panel writes the ports and both passwords into it on every boot; everything else in it is yours.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: In-game admin login (F1). Rewritten into the chosen config on every boot.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Join password. Leave blank for a public server.

variables.name: Query Port
variables.description: Steam query port, which is what puts the server in the browser. Needs its own allocation and cannot equal the game port.

variables.name: Config Source
variables.description: Where the install script fetches the config set from. Files already in configs/ are left alone.

variables.name: App ID
variables.description: Steam app ID of the Holdfast: Nations At War dedicated server. Do not change.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Update the server through SteamCMD on every boot.

variables.name: Beta ID
variables.description: Beta branch of the steam app. Leave blank to install the normal branch.

variables.name: Beta Password
variables.description: Password for a beta branch, should one require it. Leave blank for no password.
